lines.text: One slip, and Ana caught herself on her hands.
Gravel in the scrape, three miles still to go.
Wiping it on her pants would only push the dirt in.
She rinsed the scrape with clean water from her bottle until the grit was gone,
patted it dry, and covered it with a bandage from the kit that lives in her daypack.
Save this for your next fall hike.
